meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'go, walk', paired with 'пойти'.

examples.text: Я иду домой.
examples.trans: I'm going home.

examples.text: Он идёт на второй срок.
examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'водить'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'bring', paired with 'привести'.

examples.text: Быстро иди и приводи квартиру в порядок.
examples.trans: Go quickly and tidy up the apartment.

examples.text: Приводи её сегодня на вечеринку!
examples.trans: Bring her to the party tonight!

examples.text: Сегодня ты приводишь её к Димону.
examples.trans: Tonight you bring her to Dimon's place.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'apartment' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Быстро иди и приводи квартиру в порядок.
examples.trans: Go quickly and tidy up the apartment.

examples.text: Это моя квартира.
examples.trans: This is my flat.

examples.text: Мы живём в квартире.
examples.trans: We live in a flat.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'коро'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Денис, скорее, мы в кино опаздываем!
examples.trans: Denis, hurry, we are running late for the cinema!

examples.text: Скорее всего, вы про меня слышали.
examples.trans: Most likely, you have already heard about me.

examples.text: Никита, иди скорее вызывай сюда скорую!
examples.trans: Nikita, go quickly and call an ambulance here!

подъехать.gloss: to drive up, arrive by car

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ъехать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to drive up, arrive by car'.

related.gloss: not to to drive up (negated infinitive)

examples.text: Я тоже могу туда подъехать!
examples.trans: I can drive over there too!

examples.text: Такси уже подъехало к нашему дому.
examples.trans: The taxi has already driven up to our house.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'all', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Всё нормально.
examples.trans: Everything's fine.

examples.text: Как вы все знаете...
examples.trans: As you all know...

examples.text: Поделись со всеми.
examples.trans: Share with everyone.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'together', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Смотри, чаевые и визитка сразу вместе.
examples.trans: Look, a tip and a business card together at once.

examples.text: Смотри, вы и на работе вместе.
examples.trans: Look, you two are together at work too.

examples.text: А мы скоро подъедем все вместе.
examples.trans: And we will all arrive together soon.
